ck_stock_location_tracking.name: ck_stock_location_tracking
ck_stock_location_tracking.value:
("stock_location_balance"."tracking_key" = 'none' and "stock_location_balance"."lot_id" is null and "stock_location_balance"."serial_id" is null)
    or ("stock_location_balance"."tracking_key" like 'lot:%' and "stock_location_balance"."lot_id" is not null and "stock_location_balance"."serial_id" is null)
    or ("stock_location_balance"."tracking_key" like 'serial:%' and "stock_location_balance"."serial_id" is not null)

ck_sales_discount_rule_pct.name: ck_sales_discount_rule_pct
ck_sales_discount_rule_pct.value:
"sales_discount_rule"."discount_pct" >= 0 and "sales_discount_rule"."discount_pct" <= 100
      and ("sales_discount_rule"."approval_threshold_pct" is null
        or ("sales_discount_rule"."approval_threshold_pct" >= 0 and "sales_discount_rule"."approval_threshold_pct" <= 100))

ck_activity_target.name: ck_activity_target
ck_activity_target.value: "activity"."opportunity_id" is not null or "activity"."customer_id" is not null

ck_asset_category.name: ck_asset_category
ck_asset_category.value: "asset"."category" in ('Plant & Machinery', 'Vehicles', 'Lab Equipment', 'Furniture & Fixtures', 'IT Equipment', 'Warehouse Equipment')

ck_project_time_entry_void_state.name: ck_project_time_entry_void_state
ck_project_time_entry_void_state.value:
("project_time_entry"."status" = 'active' and "project_time_entry"."void_reason" is null and "project_time_entry"."voided_at" is null)
      or ("project_time_entry"."status" = 'voided' and "project_time_entry"."void_reason" is not null and "project_time_entry"."voided_at" is not null)
